cc:Work.dc:title: Linux Scatter Field v2 / Kit Remix
cc:Work.dc:description: Scatter-field backdrop rebuilt from open-license icon sources: solid brand-mark anchors (Tux, Android robot, Termux, Debian, Bash), Feather outline chorus, small glyph sprinkle, Termux-authentic shell fragments. Sources and licenses documented in the icon kit's SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md.
